facts.fact: The Presidency says the Commission de l'informatique et des libertes, led by president Dr Halguieta Nassa/Trawina, handed its 2022 activity report to the Head of State on 23 February 2024.

BFA.note: About 100 complaints are said to be registered, not settled, and no ruling against a named organisation is stated.

facts.fact: The CIL, headed by president Dr Halguieta Nassa/Trawina, reported its 2022 activities to the Head of State in February 2024.
facts.system: Commission de l'informatique et des libertes (CIL)

facts.fact: The CIL president reported that in 2022 about 15,000 people were trained, over 190 personal data projects were processed as formalities and about a hundred complaints were registered.
facts.system: Commission de l'informatique et des libertes (CIL)

BFA.note: The document says nothing of a digital channel for feedback on public services.
The document gives no school internet figure; digital education is only a planned CIL activity.
